rec: Kharedst's memoirs or book of the dead for teleports
Fairy ring access for quick access to Molch Island (DJR)

st.t: Search the tent in the south east of the Kebos Lowlands. Fairy ring BLS is closest: head south-east from it.
Search the camping equipment for some secateurs.
Type these words into the word translations, one at a time, choosing Yes. to enter another: Island, Water, Time, Vessel, North. Enter all five, or the hole on Molch Island won't appear.
Travel to Molch island via Boaty, located on the west/north/east sides of Lake Molch.
Enter the hole on Molch Island.
Inspect the vines to the south.
Search the south west stone table.
Read the stone tablet, and take the note after closing the tablet's interface.
Type these words into the word translations, one at a time, choosing Yes. to enter another: West, Poison, Body, Food, Earth.
Travel via Boaty to Molch. From there, run west and then south to Xeric's Shrine.
Enter the hole next to Xeric's Shrine.
Search the south east stone table.
Type these words into the word translations, one at a time, choosing Yes. to enter another: Make, Yes, No, Move, Arrive, East, South.
Enter the hole in the Ruins of Morra, south west of Shayzien.
Type these words into the word translations, one at a time, choosing Yes. to enter another: Few, Big, Sun, Moon, Life, Death, Mind, Home, Air, Fire.
Read the final stone tablet again.
